description: Land Title Settlement Department - Senapura, Tissamaharamaya D/S Division, Hambantota District - Cad. Map No. 830072
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and land classifications. The content focuses entirely on land ownership registration and title settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
